web-apps.name: Web Apps & Platforms
web-apps.tagline: Full-stack web applications built to scale.
description: We build full-stack web applications, SaaS platforms, dashboards, and portals that handle real load and real users. From MVPs to production-scale systems, we architect for the long term.
Our stack is modern, our deployments are fast, and our code is clean. Whether you need a customer-facing product or an internal tool, we deliver software that works.
We think through the data model, the auth layer, the API design, and the performance characteristics before writing a single line of code.

description: Your website is your most important salesperson. We build marketing sites, landing pages, and company websites that are fast, SEO-optimized, and built to convert visitors into customers.
We combine sharp design with technical rigor — making sure your site loads fast, ranks well, and reflects your brand with precision.
Every site we build is mobile-first, accessible, and structured for search engines from the ground up.

mobile-apps.name: Mobile Apps
mobile-apps.tagline: iOS and Android from a single codebase.

From idea to App Store, we handle the full lifecycle: design, development, testing, and submission. We build for performance, offline capability, and a great user experience.
We have experience with complex mobile features — push notifications, biometric auth, geolocation, camera integrations, and payment flows.

faqItems.question: Do you work with non-technical founders?
faqItems.answer: Absolutely. A large part of our work is with founders who have great ideas but no engineering background. We translate your product vision into technical requirements, explain trade-offs in plain language, and keep you in the loop at every step.

faqItems.question: What's your typical timeline?
faqItems.answer: A business website typically takes 2–3 weeks. A web app MVP runs 6–12 weeks, and a mobile app 6–12 weeks as well, depending on complexity. We establish a clear timeline before starting any project and commit to hitting those milestones.

faqItems.question: Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Every project includes a post-launch support period (varies by package). After that, we offer ongoing retainer arrangements for maintenance, updates, and continued development.

faqItems.question: Can I start with a smaller package and scale up?
faqItems.answer: Yes. We build with scalability in mind from the start. Many clients begin with a website or a focused first version of their app and expand as the product grows. We'll architect things so that scaling up doesn't require rewriting everything.

faqItems.question: What if I already have a design?
faqItems.answer: Great — we'll work with it. We're comfortable building from Figma files, existing brand guidelines, or partial designs. If you need design work too, we can handle that as well.

faqItems.question: Do you sign NDAs?
faqItems.answer: Yes. We're happy to sign an NDA before discussing your project. Confidentiality is standard practice for us.

studio-mobile.name: VIBE
studio-mobile.metaDescription: VIBE is Flintworks Studio's iOS app for Budapest's electronic nightlife — every event, lineup and ticket on one map, automated event import with AI flyer reading, and ratings from verified attendees. Live on the App Store.
studio-mobile.problem: Budapest electronic nightlife discovery is fragmented across Instagram, Facebook Events, ticket pages, and chats. Fans — primarily local scene regulars around 20–35 — need one trustworthy place for what's on, where, lineup, and price path — not another nearest-venue map. They also need trust signals after nights out. VIBE positions as a personal nightlife OS: discovery, scene graph, and ratings, without becoming a primary ticket vendor.
studio-mobile.approach: Solo technical build as co-founder inside Flintworks Studio: a React Native/Expo app, a custom Express/Postgres API, an admin panel, and a scraper worker that imports events from Oneticket, Cooltix and Resident Advisor. Product thesis: win on catalog completeness, lineups and ratings; send people to the ticket sellers and keep their tickets in an offline wallet — never sell tickets ourselves.
architecture: Mobile: Expo/React Native, Expo Router, Mapbox map with clustering, Apple/Google/Facebook and email sign-in, PostHog analytics, Expo push notifications.
API: Express 5, PostgreSQL (65 migrations), Zod validation, JWT auth, role-aware surfaces for users, artists, organisers and platform admins.
Jobs: Redis + BullMQ worker for scheduled ticket refresh, ratings recalculation and rating-prompt pushes.
Ingestion: a scraper worker pulls events from Oneticket, Cooltix and Resident Advisor; each new flyer gets one Gemini vision pass to fill in structured fields.
Ratings: one short post-event flow, open only to attendees verified by a wallet ticket or by being at the venue during the event.
Ops: GitHub Actions deploys the API, worker, admin panel and scraper, with health-checked restarts on a VPS; 179 test files across server, scraper and app.
studio-mobile.challenge: Keep a Budapest nightlife catalog complete and fresh while inferring missing structure with AI — especially from flyers — without runaway inference cost. Separately: set times often arrive late; artists lack clean genre tags; ratings only matter if they're trustworthy and quick.
solution: Scrape three ticketing sources automatically, and run Gemini only on new events' flyers — known URLs just refresh their ticket offers.
Lock scheduled jobs to zero paid AI calls, and give artist genre inference a 9-month cooldown after an early cost spike.
Let the community upload a lineup screenshot: AI extracts set times by room, and nothing is saved until the user confirms.
Infer artist genres from a fixed allowlist, at most five per artist, so discovery filters stay clean.
Gate ratings to verified attendance — a wallet ticket, or being at the venue during the event — and keep the flow to four quick steps: entry, vibe, lineup, confirm.
features: Map-first Budapest discovery — what's on, where, and what's open now
Automated event import from three ticketing sources, with AI flyer reading
Room-by-room timetables with “now playing”, including multi-day festivals
Ratings from verified attendees for events, artists and venue vibe
Offline ticket wallet — share a ticket PDF in, the QR code is ready at the door
Community lineup AI — set times from a single screenshot

about.heading: Built
about.subheading: Flintworks exists to build software that actually works — on time, on budget, and built to last.

story.heading: A focused agency that punches above its weight.
paragraphs: Flintworks is a senior-level software agency with a simple philosophy: do fewer things, but do them exceptionally well. We're not trying to be everything to everyone — we specialize in the work we're genuinely great at.

We take on projects we believe in and treat every build as if it were our own product. That means asking hard questions, pushing back on scope that doesn't serve your goals, and caring deeply about what ships.
When you work with us, you're working with people who have shipped real products to real users — not interns learning on your budget. We've seen what goes wrong at scale, and we build accordingly.

craft.title: Craft over shortcuts
craft.body: We take the time to do things right. A quick hack today is a costly rewrite tomorrow. We build things that last.

transparency.title: Transparency always
